root_cause: The daily winner selector correctly transitions the frozen Instagram recommendation to accepted, while the downstream orchestrator reused generic recommendation eligibility that only allowed suggested/empty status. The immutable winner was therefore rejected after successful selection and proof.
prevention: A persisted daily winner is downstream-authoritative when recommendation_id matches the winner row, evidence.daily_winner=true, and status is suggested or accepted.
Generic non-winner recommendations remain restricted to suggested/empty status.
Never select a second Instagram winner to recover from downstream lifecycle-state mismatch.
